risks.description: Macroeconomic risk is rated Substantial. External economic shocks, regional instability and related uncertainties, or a downturn in global venture capital markets could reduce investor confidence and slow private capital mobilization. Additionally, Jordan's nascent venture capital market and competition from more developed ecosystems in neighboring countries may impact startup retention and funding.

Other risks are rated Substantial and relate to geopolitical risk. Jordan's strategic location makes it susceptible to a complex set of geopolitical challenges that have intensified in recent years, due to the current Conflict in the Middle East and its repercussions for investment, trade, and tourism in the region. Increasing geopolitical risks may prompt adjustments in policy and budgetary priorities and/or contribute to delays in implementation.
risks.mitigation: By combining regional and global diplomacy, building international partnerships, staying the course on political and economic modernization reforms, implementing prudent fiscal policies, and strategic security measures, Jordan has maintained its resilience and stability despite continuous crises.

notes: Text-driven extraction: overall risk Moderate; only 2 of 9 SORT categories (Macroeconomic, Other) are rated Substantial and narrated in Section V (paras 83-85); the other 7 rated categories (Political and Governance=Moderate, Sector Strategies and Policies=Low, Technical Design=Low, Institutional Capacity=Low, Fiduciary=Moderate, Environment and Social=Moderate, Stakeholders=Low) are rated but not narrated. R01 (Macroeconomic) has no explicit mitigation sentence in the narrative - left null per schema rather than fabricated. Part of the short-register/hallucination-test subgroup (with P-KHM, P-PAK, P-MAR) per the 2026-07-19 decision in corpus_manifest.csv. SORT table spans pages 7-8 (row 9 'Other' and row 10 'Overall' are on page 8) - this was originally mis-recorded as page 7 only during initial text-only assessment, a leakage bug caught and fixed 2026-07-19 (see corpus_manifest.csv notes), the same failure mode as the Serbia narrative-boundary bug but for the SORT table rather than the Key Risks narrative.
